chalisa.do1: Bowing my head to Bagalāmukhī, I write this Chālīsā today; be gracious to me always, and may my work be fulfilled.
chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory, victory to Śrī Bagalā Mother, the primal Śakti, protector of the whole world. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Mother, your face is like a crane's; from this your name became famous. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: The moon on your forehead and your earrings have a beauty all their own; gods, men and women sing your praise. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: Yellow garments shine on your body; in your hands are a mallet and a mace. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: You have three eyes and a garland of campaka flowers at your throat; boundless radiance shines from your forehead. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: A jewelled throne is resplendent; seeing its beauty, all people are enchanted. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: Great queen, your seat is yellow; you grant boons to your devotees. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Your ornaments are yellow and your sandal paste yellow too; gods, men and nāgas all bow to you. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: In this way one should hold the meditation in the heart; so say the Vedas, the Purāṇas and the saints. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Now I set forth the way of worship, by which sorrow is destroyed. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: First one should fly a yellow flag, and dress the goddess in yellow garments. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: Kumkum, unbroken rice, laddus of gram flour, abīr, gulāl, betel nut, sandal paste, ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: garlands, turmeric, fruit and betel leaves: one should offer them all and hold her in meditation in the heart. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: With incense, a lamp and a camphor wick, one should then perform the āratī with love. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: One should praise her with both hands joined: Mother, fulfil the wishes of my heart. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: Mother, devotion to you is the mine of all happiness; be gracious to me, knowing me as your own. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Destroy the threefold affliction and all sorrow; dispel the darkness and increase knowledge. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: Again and again I entreat you: give me unbroken devotion and knowledge. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: At the end of the worship one should have a fire offering made; that person obtains the fruit the heart desires. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Whoever makes an offering of mustard seed into the fire, all that moves and does not move comes under his power. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Whoever mixes sesame and rice with milk and has the fire offering made with devotion and love, ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: sorrow and poverty do not touch him; surely all happiness and wealth are his. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Whoever offers aśoka flowers into the fire, his home fills with happiness and wealth. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: Let the fruit of the silk-cotton tree be offered into the fire, and surely all one's enemies waste away. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: Whoever offers guggul and ghee into the fire, the king comes under his power. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Whoever has guggul offered into the fire with sesame, all his bonds are cut. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Those who recite the seed-syllables and chant your seed-mantra, ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: who perform the japa at night for one month: all their torments are removed. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Where there is a pure spot of ground in the house, there the practitioner should perform the japa. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: He surely obtains the fruit he wishes; let him have no doubt of this. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Or let the practitioner go to the bank of a river and perform the japa with his mind intent. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: Whoever performs ten thousand japa, all his works are accomplished. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Whoever performs the japa a hundred thousand times, his fame spreads far. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Whoever repeats your name with his mind intent destroys his enemies in a short time. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Whoever repeats the name for seven nights, all his wishes are fulfilled. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Whoever performs the japa for nine days, his body becomes free of disease. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: A childless woman who meditates on you obtains the four fruits, a son and the rest. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Meditating morning, evening and noon brings welfare. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: How far can I tell your glory? Your name is ever auspicious and brings blessing. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Whoever recites the Chālīsā daily, Śiva, the lord of Gaurī, is gracious to him. ॥40॥
chalisa.do2: I am the son of Santaśaraṇa, Kulapati Miśra by name; I live in the district of Haridvāra, my home the village of Haripura.
chalisa.do3: In the year nineteen hundred and ninety-five, in the bright fortnight of the month of Śrāvaṇa, I, the servant of your feet, composed this Chālīsā.
